title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
abstract: arXiv:2611.21852v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. translated_title: MoE扩散解码的隐性代价：剖析与修复采样器
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型通过迭代去噪整个token画布来进行解码，因此每次前向传播都需要在整个“画布×词表”的logits张量上运行逐token的采样与停止流水线。我们在带宽受限的边缘加速器（NVIDIA GB10）上对一个26B参数的扩散混合专家模型进行了单用户解码的性能剖析，并报告了一个容易被忽视的发现：在权重量化之后，这一logits流水线（而非专家GEMM计算）成为解码时间的最大消耗者。与自回归解码不同——自回归解码每提交一个token只需对单个位置的logits进行采样——扩散解码每输出一个token需要处理S倍的logits条目，其中S为去噪步数。我们证明该流水线在很大程度上是冗余的或可融合的，并以两个无损层级将其移除：一个是比特精确层级，其输出与参考解码器字节完全一致；另一个是精度对等层级，使用融合的单（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现量化后MoE扩散语言模型的解码瓶颈在于画布级logits采样流水线而非专家矩阵计算，并提出两个无损优化层级（比特精确与精度对等）将其消除，从而大幅加速解码。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that after weight quantization, the canvas-wide logits sampling pipeline—not the expert GEMMs—is the dominant decode-time cost in MoE diffusion LMs, and removes it via two lossless tiers (bit-exact and accuracy-parity) for significant decoding speedup.
